item.title: Django QuerySet/Q Object SQL Injection via `_connector` Kwarg (CVE-2025-64459)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.1) — web · CVE-2025-64459. Status: Weaponized. Affects: Django ORM (QuerySet.filter() / Q object construction). Tags: django, python, sql-injection, queryset, q-object, orm, cwe-89, data-exposure, sqlite.
